headline: Deploy {arm:brisk-s.few}. It satisfies every accuracy floor and stays well under the latency budget.
lede: {arm:brisk-s.few} delivers {measure.balanced_accuracy.brisk-s.few.mean|pct} Balanced accuracy at {measure.latency_ms.brisk-s.few.p95} p95 latency. A stricter Cell floor above {cells.complex.news.brisk-s.few.accuracy.mean|pct} would eliminate all options.

slots.text: Adopt {arm:brisk-s.few} for production routing. It achieves {measure.balanced_accuracy.brisk-s.few.mean|pct} Balanced accuracy, clears all cell floors, and operates at {measure.cost_per_1m.brisk-s.few.mean} per million turns.

{arm:atlas-m.rubric} breaches the latency budget at {measure.latency_ms.atlas-m.rubric.p95}; {arm:brisk-s.rubric} also breaches it at {measure.latency_ms.brisk-s.rubric.p95}; and {arm:nano-xs.few} misses the Cell floor in complex news at {cells.complex.news.nano-xs.few.accuracy.mean|pct}.
The weakest margin is {weakest.arm}: {weakest.value|pct} against {weakest.criterion} at {weakest.threshold|pct}, a gap of {weakest.margin} points. Complex news remains the most vulnerable cell.
Test whether reducing few-shot exemplars from twelve to six cuts latency further without dropping complex news accuracy below {criteria.cell_floor.threshold|pct}.

method.text: Each candidate evaluated across {scoreboard.brisk-s.few.cases} turns spanning nine complexity and domain target cells.
A turn passes only if both complexity level and domain category match the gold label exactly.
Unweighted arithmetic mean of accuracy figures across all nine target-matrix cells.
Requires observed accuracy to reach at least {criteria.cell_floor.threshold|pct} in every individual target cell.
Requires p95 response time to remain below {criteria.p95.threshold}.
Token usage measured per arm and priced at vendor list rates per million turns.

sections.headline: Few-shot prompting yields the largest accuracy gains across all model families
sections.takeaway: Balanced accuracy rises substantially with few-shot examples while rubric reasoning offers diminishing returns.

sections.headline: {arm:brisk-s.few} clears the Cell floor across all nine cells
sections.takeaway: Cell accuracy spans from {cells.complex.news.brisk-s.few.accuracy.mean|pct} in complex news to {cells.simple.conv.brisk-s.few.accuracy.mean|pct} in simple conversational turns.

sections.headline: Errors concentrate primarily in complexity classification between adjacent tiers
sections.takeaway: Domain classification remains highly reliable while medium complexity turns show the greatest confusion.

explore.title: Explore gate thresholds
explore.recomputes: Adjusting the p95 latency budget or cell floor gate shifts survivor status; raising the cell floor above {cells.complex.news.brisk-s.few.accuracy.mean|pct} eliminates {arm:brisk-s.few}.
